name: Museum Grünes Haus
kurzbeschreibung: The Museum im Grünen Haus in Reutte showcases valuable art treasures and the guild history of the Außerfern region in a magnificent 16th-century townhouse.
beschreibung:
Overview

The Museum im Grünen Haus, located in the heart of the historic market town of Reutte, is one of western Tyrol's cultural treasures. Housed in a heritage-listed patrician residence from the 16th century, the building immediately catches the eye with its vibrant green facade and brilliant trompe-l'œil murals. Originally home to wealthy regional administrators and merchants, the house reflects the historic prosperity Reutte gained from its strategic position along the Via Claudia Augusta. The award-winning museum presents an engaging journey through regional history, from prehistoric trade routes to traditional guild craftsmanship and fine baroque art.

Route & Requirements

Exploring the museum requires no physical exertion and is an ideal cultural experience for individual travellers, couples, and families alike. Exhibition galleries are spread across multiple floors of the historic timbered mansion. Visitors should allow approximately one and a half to two hours to fully appreciate the permanent collection and temporary exhibitions. Interactive display stations and multilingual information materials make the tour fascinating for younger visitors as well.

Visiting & Getting There

Reutte has excellent connections via the Außerfern Railway and regional bus services from Innsbruck and Bavaria. From Reutte in Tirol railway station, it is an easy five-minute walk through the market town to the museum on Untermarkt. Motorists can use several nearby town car parks or the parking garage by the municipal hall. The museum is open year-round with regular seasonal hours (typically Tuesday to Sunday). Holders of regional guest cards benefit from discounted or complimentary admission.

Tips

Do not miss the notable collection of paintings by the famed Zeiller family of baroque artists and the inspiring works of Anna Stainer-Knittel, the pioneering female painter from the Lechtal who inspired the famous Tyrolean legend of the Geierwally. Combine your visit with an excursion to nearby Ehrenberg Castle ensemble and cross the breathtaking highline179 suspension bridge.
